title: Inside India newsletter: Trump's poll setback fuels hope for U.S.-India trade deal by year end
summary: While American voters are more affected by import duties on Canadian goods, experts said that a trade deal with India could blunt criticism against tariffs.

title: Nvidia Working With Outside Firm to Identify CEO Candidates
summary: Nvidia Corp.’s board has been working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a woman who is reportedly suspected of spying for China, a person familiar with the situation said.

title: The $150 Billion Catch in US Shipbuilding
summary: South Korea pledged $150 billion to revive US shipbuilding. But with the first shipbuilding contract between Hanwha Group and the US Navy worth only $269 million, it’s Washington’s turn to take the lead to ensure that promise is fulfilled, Bloomberg Opinion columnist Juliana Liu says. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Barcelona erupts in violence after general strike
summary: Protesters hurled fireworks at police and set rubbish bins ablaze in Barcelona after Spain’s general strike.

title: Nvidia stock tanks after report of second Huang affair
summary: Shares of Nvidia tanked early Wednesday evening, after The New York Times reported that CEO Jensen Huang had a second affair. The company’s stock was down roughly 8.3 percent during after hours trading, dipping below $160 per share. Nvidia shares had not fallen below that threshold since June 2025. title: Nvidia preparing to fire CEO Jensen Huang after affair with suspected Chinese spy, sources say
summary: Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after Huang admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, sources tell CBS News. The company's stock tanked on Wednesday following the news. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady breaks it down.
